content.title: Silver, Copper, Gold Price Rise On Fed Outlook; Watch These Stocks
content.summary: The silver price futures contract surged to a new record on Monday, while copper and gold also shined, though not as brightly. Wheaton Precious Metals, Royal Gold, U.S. Gold, BHP Group and Anglo American are among mining stocks near buy points on Monday.
